jokes.text: I fixed the bug. It was a loose keyboard-chair connection.
Our best diagnostic tool is still: did you try turning it off and on again?
The issue was resolved by applying advanced technique: reading the error message.
I closed 12 tabs and gained 30% more troubleshooting speed.
My watch says I am on time. My calendar strongly disagrees.
I bought a smart watch to count steps. It mostly counts coffee walks.
My watch is water resistant, but not meeting resistant.
I wear a watch to stay punctual, and as a tiny wrist dashboard.
I started biking for cardio, but stayed for the snacks afterward.
My bike has two gears: fast and why is this hill so steep?
Cycling is balance, momentum, and pretending the wind is a training partner.
A bike ride is just a moving meditation with occasional leg complaints.
Dad mode: active. Puns loaded. Thermostat protected.
I am reading a book on anti-gravity. It is impossible to put down.
I know 25 letters of the alphabet. I do not know y.
As a dad, I tell classic jokes so the next generation can groan properly.
